facts: Reuters reported eight wallets linked to the creator withdrew about USD 99 million from the liquidity pool.
Reuters reported the token fell by more than 95 percent after its surge.
CoinDesk, citing Nansen on-chain analysis, reported 86 percent of traders lost money, totalling USD 251 million.
impact: fast attention-driven launches can degrade before ordinary momentum signals are useful
designImplication: New-mint discovery and price momentum are not sufficient execution authority. Ownership concentration, liquidity, provenance and critical unknowns need veto power.
mitigationInBuild: economic-owner aggregation of sampled largest accounts
